user.description: Enter your personal access token. To find it, go to log.concept2.com → Edit Profile → Applications (in the menu on the left) → Concept2 Logbook API → View Token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Concept2 Logbook
reauth_confirm.description: Your Concept2 access token no longer works. Enter a new personal access token. To find it, go to log.concept2.com → Edit Profile → Applications (in the menu on the left) → Concept2 Logbook API → View Token. If you regenerated the token, use the new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Concept2 Logbook API.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Concept2 account.

abort.already_configured: This Concept2 account is already configured.

init.description: Enter a new personal access token for this Concept2 account. To find it, go to log.concept2.com → Edit Profile → Applications (in the menu on the left) → Concept2 Logbook API → View Token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Concept2 Logbook API.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Concept2 account.

poll_failing.title: Concept2 Logbook cannot be reached
poll_failing.description: The last {failures} attempts to get data from the Concept2 Logbook API failed. The sensors show the last data that Home Assistant received. Home Assistant tries again at the next refresh. To try now, press the Refresh button of the integration. This issue clears after a successful refresh.
